HomePage.title: EloChessPlanner
HomePage.description: Generate FIDE-compliant Swiss pairings for your family tournaments and forecast next month's Elo change.

PlayersPage.title: Players
PlayersPage.description: Register family members and occasional guests. The official rating follows a FIDE, then FFE, then chess.com priority and is used to seed the first round of a tournament.

ImportPage.title: Import results for {name}
ImportPage.csvHelp: Columns: date,opponent,result,eloBefore,eloAfter,source. Result is win/loss/draw, source is fide/ffe/chesscom/lichess. eloBefore may be left empty.
ImportPage.ffeHelp: Paste the link to a tournament page on echecs.asso.fr (FicheTournoi.aspx). All rounds for the named player are imported; since the FFE only publishes one rating per player per tournament (not per game), a per-game rating curve is reconstructed using the standard FIDE formula and this app's K-factor rule. Enter the player's name exactly as printed on the FFE results page (e.g. "MNASRI Seji").
ImportPage.ffePlayerNameLabel: Player name (as printed on the FFE page)
ImportPage.forecastBasis: Statistical projection from {gamesPerMonth} games/month and K-factor {kFactor}, based on recent results. Not a guarantee.
ImportPage.forecastInsufficientData: Not enough imported games yet to forecast a trend (at least 2 games with a known starting rating are needed).

TournamentsPage.title: Tournaments
TournamentsPage.description: Create a home tournament and generate FIDE-inspired Swiss pairings round after round.

NewTournamentPage.title: New tournament
NewTournamentPage.participantsHelp: Select at least two players. The seeded rating (FIDE / FFE / chess.com) is frozen for this tournament.
NewTournamentPage.noPlayersWarning: No player registered yet. Add players first.

TournamentDetailPage.pasteHelp: One line per board, format: White - Black: Result (1-0, 0-1, 1/2-1/2).
TournamentDetailPage.tournamentComplete: This tournament has completed all its planned rounds.
